title: Starlark http_archive cannot be referred by //external:[repo_name] from another external repo

labels.name: P2
labels.description: We'll consider working on this in future. (Assignee optional)

labels.name: team-ExternalDeps
labels.description: External dependency handling, remote repositiories, WORKSPACE file.

body:
### Description of the problem / feature request:

A external repo pulled in by Starlark http_archive cannot be referred by //external:_[repo_name]_ from another external repo. @_[repo_name]_//:_[repo_name]_ works just fine.

### Bugs: what's the simplest, easiest way to reproduce this bug? Please provide a minimal example if possible.

```
git clone https://github.com/trchen1033/bazel_http_archive_bug.git
cd bazel_http_archive_bug/main
bazel build @greeting//:greeting
```

### What operating system are you running Bazel on?

macOS 10.14

### What's the output of `bazel info release`?

release 0.19.2

### Any other information, logs, or outputs that you want to share?

The error message generated from the commands above:
```

		ctx.download_and_extract(all_urls, "", ctx.attr.sha256, ctx.attr...., ...)
type 'ctx' has no method download_and_extract(list, string, string, string, string)

INFO: 0 processes.
FAILED: Build did NOT complete successfully (0 packages loaded, 0 targets configured)
```
It may or may not be related, the following command will crash bazel server:
```
bazel build //external:greeting
```
